stylePrefix: Original game art for Naija Street Life, a 2D Nigerian street-life game. STYLE: hand-painted gouache and watercolour texture with confident dark brown-black ink outlines, muted earthy slightly desaturated palette with warm accents, weathered and lived-in contemporary Lagos, soft painted shading lit from the top-left. Match the painting style, palette and line quality of the reference image if one is attached, but do NOT copy its composition.
styleSuffix: No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no border, no UI.

assets.name: veh-danfo-topdown
assets.prompt: ONE isolated vehicle sprite: a yellow Lagos danfo minibus (Toyota HiAce style) with two black stripes along the roof edges and a loaded roof rack with bags and a bundle tied with rope, seen from DIRECTLY ABOVE in a true top-down view (only the roof/top is visible, no side panels, no perspective), the FRONT pointing to the RIGHT edge of the image, perfectly horizontal and centred, on a fully transparent background, with a thin dark ink outline. No ground, no shadow, no people visible except where stated.
